---
name: Feature request
about: Propose an improvement or new capability
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem / motivation

What problem does this solve, or what capability gap does it fill?
Why does this matter for the project's goals?

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature clearly. Include:
- What it does
- How a user would invoke it (CLI flags, new script, dashboard panel, etc.)
- Which files would change

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you considered and why you chose this one.

## Success criteria

How would we know this feature is working correctly?
Include any QA metrics, expected output format, or observable behaviour.

## Impact assessment

| Area | Impact |
|------|--------|
| Pipeline | None / Low / Medium / High |
| Dashboard | None / Low / Medium / High |
| Prompt | None / Low / Medium / High |
| Output schema | None / Low / Medium / High |
| Breaking change | Yes / No |

## Additional context

Mockups, example output, references to similar implementations, etc.
